title: Turn Creator Audio Into Searchable Text with ElevenLabs
markdown:
If you are comparing transcription tools, ElevenLabs Audio to Text is positioned around structured transcripts rather than plain text alone. Its Scribe product can label up to 32 speakers, timestamp each word, and tag non-speech events such as laughter and applause. That makes it relevant for recordings where attribution and locating a moment in the source matter, including panels, interviews, lectures, and calls. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text](https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text)

Check your recordings against the supported workflow before deciding. ElevenLabs says users can upload MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, and major video formats; transcripts can be exported as TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT, JSON, or HTML. The editor supports word corrections, segment splitting or merging, and speaker-label reassignment, with word-level timing retained. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text](https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text)

Language coverage may be a key consideration for multilingual work: the product page states that Scribe transcribes 90+ languages and can automatically detect languages. If a recording includes multiple participants, review whether the stated 32-speaker limit and the available export format fit how your team edits, captions, quotes, or imports transcripts. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text](https://elevenlabs.io/audio-to-text)

For cost planning, the pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 per month with 10,000 credits and Speech to Text included. It also states an approximate Speech to Text cost of 330 credits per minute, and says credits are shared across products. Paid monthly plans listed include Starter at $6 for 30,000 credits, Creator at $22 for 121,000 credits (with an $11 first-month offer shown), Pro at $99 for 600,000 credits, Scale at $299 for 1.8 million credits, and Business at $990 for 6 million credits; taxes, levies, and duties are excluded. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

A sensible final check is to confirm your expected minutes, required languages, speaker count, and desired download format against the current product and pricing pages before subscribing.

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.
